001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import org.clafer.common.Check;
004import org.clafer.domain.BoolDomain;
005
006/**
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 */
010public class IrSubsetEq extends IrAbstractBool {
011
012    private final IrSetExpr subset, superset;
013
014    public IrSubsetEq(IrSetExpr subset, IrSetExpr superset, BoolDomain domain) {
015        super(domain);
016        this.subset = Check.notNull(subset);
017        this.superset = Check.notNull(superset);
018    }
019
020    public IrSetExpr getSubset() {
021        return subset;
022    }
023
024    public IrSetExpr getSuperset() {
025        return superset;
026    }
027
028    @Override
029    public IrBoolExpr negate() {
030        return new IrNot(this, getDomain().invert());
031    }
032
033    @Override
034    public boolean isNegative() {
035        return false;
036    }
037
038    @Override
039    public <A, B> B accept(IrBoolExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
040        return visitor.visit(this, a);
041    }
042
043    @Override
044    public <A, B> B accept(IrIntExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
045        return visitor.visit(this, a);
046    }
047
048    @Override
049    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
050        if (obj instanceof IrSubsetEq) {
051            IrSubsetEq other = (IrSubsetEq) obj;
052            return subset.equals(other.subset) && superset.equals(other.superset) && super.equals(other);
053        }
054        return false;
055    }
056
057    @Override
058    public int hashCode() {
059        return subset.hashCode() ^ superset.hashCode();
060    }
061
062    @Override
063    public String toString() {
064        return subset + " ⊆ " + superset;
065    }
066}
